texts.caption:
Hello MSP Scholars! ✨ 

Wondering what it takes to prepare for medical school beyond the classroom? Join us for an engaging Fireside Chat with Jasmine G. as she shares her personal experiences navigating the pre-med journey and developing the skills and competencies that help prepare future physicians. 🩺

Inspired by the AAMC’s Premed Competencies for Entering Medical Students, this conversation will explore lessons learned, challenges along the way, and the importance of growth, communication, teamwork, and service in becoming a future healthcare professional.

Whether you’re just beginning your pre-med journey or preparing for your next steps, this is a great opportunity to gain insight, reflect on your own experiences, and connect with fellow MSP scholars! You can find the event’s location in our MSP Canvas. 

Date: Thursday, October 8, 2026
Time: 3:30-4:30 pm
Location: Check MSP Canvas
